name: TriQuanta Labs
india_angle: TriQuanta Labs has locations in Hyderabad and Amaravati Quantum Valley, India.
summary: TriQuanta Labs is focused on developing hybrid quantum computing platforms that integrate neutral atoms and trapped ions to achieve high computational power. Their technology is applicable in various industries, including pharmaceuticals, finance, and clean energy, where quantum computing can provide significant advantages.
technical_expertise: Neutral atoms and trapped ions integration
